title: Rokko ca$h and Marshyn cutler - VooDoo
htmlContent:
Rokko ca$h is a talented artist from Jacksonville, Florida. He comes together with Marshyn to bring a master class of lyricism and soul on this new record "a master class of lyricism and soul on this new record, "VooDoo." The record is packed with pure emceeing. Lyrically the song is impressive, and each line pops out as something to marvel at, as they all pop just right.

Rokko ca$h and Marshyn cutler come together to put on an R&B in a significant way on the new song "VooDoo." The song wastes no time setting an engaging tone with complex production that embodies the New York sound infamous with driving keys and a soulful bassline pushing things forward for us to rock to.
